ITEM 1 | Two golden-brown, pan-seared pieces of a pale protein with a crisp, slightly bronzed exterior and a flaky, moist-looking pale interior, arranged as a larger piece roughly 7 x 5 cm and a smaller piece roughly 5 x 4 cm, with dark brown mottled specks and a few small charred flecks on the surface; the larger piece is cut at an angle and sits upper right on the plate, the smaller piece sits center-left | 230
ITEM 2 | Small mushroom-like pieces with dark brown caps and pale tan, slightly moist stems, about 4 cm across in total, clustered beneath and beside the protein pieces at lower center-left, showing light browning and a glossy, slightly oily sheen | 35
ITEM 3 | Two thin strips of bright green vegetable, each about 4 to 5 cm long and about 1 cm wide, with smooth, slightly glossy surfaces and a firm, straight-edged shape, lying across the lower edge of the smaller protein piece and at its left side | 12
ITEM 4 | A few tiny scattered flecks of pale, dry, crumbly material, under 0.5 cm each, sprinkled on the plate near the protein pieces, possibly a seasoning or crumb residue | 2
